title: [Bug]: UE context release does not happen after UE goes to 'emergency calls only'.
body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

Feb 28

### Steps to reproduce

I am using srsRAN gNB and Open5GS core with COTS UE. I see `PDUSessionResourceSetupResponse` and UE then goes to 'emergengy calls only' state. There is no gNB crash and as I toggled the flight mode, I see registration request gain and then UE context release happens. I tried toggling the flight mode before the UE goes 'emergency calls only' state but same thing happened.

### Expected behaviour

context release should happen when UE is put in fight mode.
[gnb and core logs.zip](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/11276397/gnb.and.core.logs.zip)


### Observed Behaviour

context release is not initiated when UE is put in fight mode. It is initiated when same UE again attempts registration.

### eNodeB/gNodeB

srsRAN project gNB(CU-DU)

### UE Models and versions

COTS UE
